name: ramificationIdxIn_ne_zero
statement: Ideal A} [p.IsPrime] (hp : p ≠ ⊥) [IsDomain A] [IsTorsionFree A B] : p.ramificationIdxIn B ≠ 0

name: inertiaDegIn_mul_inertiaDegIn
statement: p.inertiaDegIn B * P.inertiaDegIn C = p.inertiaDegIn C

name: ramificationIdxIn_mul_ramificationIdxIn
statement: map (algebraMap A C) p ≠ ⊥) (hP : map (algebraMap B C) P ≠ ⊥) : p.ramificationIdxIn B * P.ramificationIdxIn C = p.ramificationIdxIn C

name: ramificationIdxIn_mul_ramificationIdxIn'
statement: p.ramificationIdxIn B * P.ramificationIdxIn C = p.ramificationIdxIn C

name: card_stabilizer_eq_card_inertia_mul_finrank
statement: Ideal R) [p.IsMaximal] (P : Ideal S) [P.LiesOver p] [P.IsMaximal] [Algebra.IsSeparable (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P)] : Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer G P) = Nat.card (inertia G P) * Module.finrank (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P)

name: card_inertia_eq_ramificationIdxIn
statement: Ideal R) (hp : p ≠ ⊥) (P : Ideal S) [P.LiesOver p] [P.IsMaximal] [Algebra.IsSeparable (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P)] : Nat.card (P.inertia G) = Ideal.ramificationIdxIn p S

have_tree.body: (show p.IsPrime from P.over_def p ▸ inferInstance).isMaximal hp

name: card_stabilizer_eq
statement: Ideal R) (hp : p ≠ ⊥) (P : Ideal S) [P.LiesOver p] [P.IsMaximal] [Algebra.IsSeparable (R ⧸ p) (S ⧸ P)] : Nat.card (MulAction.stabilizer G P) = p.ramificationIdxIn S * p.inertiaDegIn S

have_tree.body: (show p.IsPrime from P.over_def p ▸ inferInstance).isMaximal hp

name: exists_comap_galRestrict_eq
statement: Ideal R} {P₁ P₂ : Ideal S} (hP₁ : P₁ ∈ primesOver p S) (hP₂ : P₂ ∈ primesOver p S) : ∃ σ, P₁.comap (galRestrict R K L S σ) = P₂
